concepts.name: Admin Dashboard SPA
concepts.summary: React 19 + TypeScript single-page admin application built with Vite. UI is a hybrid of Ant Design 5 (with the React-19 patch) and MUI 9, both themed to the muted M3 scheme. Pages are lazy-loaded via lazyPages, runtime configuration is generated into env.js at container start, and OpenTelemetry web-vitals metrics are emitted from the browser.

concepts.name: Management Domains (Pages)
concepts.summary: The admin UI is organized by management domains under src/pages: Agency (list/edit with FieldGrid master data), Links (invites), TenantSettings (theme/global settings tabs), Tenants, Topics, users (accounts/agency-admins/tenant-admins/platform-admins tables), Statistic, Logs (case-handover, inactive-accounts, supervisor), Profile, Login, PasswordReset, and the public TenantOnboarding wizard. Which settings tabs render is derived per role/permission in settingsTabs.

concepts.name: API Layer
concepts.summary: src/api holds per-domain HTTP client modules (tenant, agency, admins, counselor, user, settings, statistic, invitelinks, accountInvites, tenantOnboarding, passwordReset, idAllocation, tutorial) built on a shared fetchData wrapper. Endpoint URLs are centralized in appConfig.ts and point at UserService, TenantService, AgencyService and ConsultingTypeService; data fetching/caching in the UI goes through TanStack Query v5 hooks under src/hooks.

concepts.name: M3 Design System and AntD→MUI Migration
concepts.summary: A muted Material 3 token scheme drives both UI libraries: antdM3Theme maps M3 tokens into the AntD ConfigProvider while orisoMuiTheme themes MUI 9. Custom M3 components (M3Button, M3Switch, M3FabMenu, M3NumberField, MuiFormField and friends) progressively replace AntD widgets; the migration is deliberate and incremental — AntD is still imported in roughly 179 files versus around 42 MUI files — with Form.Item kept as the form scaffolding during conversion. The mui9/antd inventory doc tracks remaining surfaces.

concepts.name: Mobile Navigation (Thumb-Reachable Redesign)
concepts.summary: New mobile navigation shell: a floating action button menu (M3FabMenu) opens the AdminMobileNav which mirrors the desktop sidebar, with per-page secondary rows, section pills and a MobileNavProvider context. Replaces the folded sidebar on small viewports; a provider re-render loop that froze the whole admin panel after one navigation was fixed in #707.

concepts.name: Statistics Dashboard
concepts.summary: Card-based statistics dashboard fed by the UserService useradmin statistics endpoints: a dashboard endpoint for platform metrics and a tutorial-statistics endpoint for onboarding-tour completion. StatisticCard renders animated values with per-metric menus and calm empty-state hints ('not yet collected') instead of fake zeros; user card preferences persist via statisticPreferences.

concepts.name: Legal Texts and DPA (AVV) Module
concepts.summary: Legal settings manage imprint, privacy and DPA content per tenant, department and agency with a TipTap-based M3 rich-text editor (FormPluginEditor). Editors open on the legal source language (pinned even when languages load late), warn on publish when the source language was left untouched, and can machine-translate on publish. The DPA side adds versioned agreements, signature tracking, DPA invite emails, and a DpaBlockerGate that locks the admin UI until the organisation DPA is signed.

concepts.name: Tenant-Admin Onboarding Wizard
concepts.summary: Public (unauthenticated) onboarding flow at /admin/tenant-onboarding/{rawToken}: an emailed account-invite link leads through account creation, organisation DPA acceptance and a mandatory-or-deferrable 2FA setup step before landing in the admin panel. Token handling and step state live in useTenantAdminOnboardingFlow; the backend counterpart is the UserService AccountInviteService.

concepts.name: Links and Invite Composer
concepts.summary: The Links page unifies invitation management: an InviteComposer for counsellor and tenant-admin invites (with derived department routing), account-invite tables with bulk actions, CSV bulk import, an email-template dialog with live EmailTemplatePreview, and an external-inbounds tab. Invites are sent through UserService invitelinks / account-invites / invite-email-templates endpoints.

concepts.name: Permissions Settings and Role Model
concepts.summary: Function-access settings render permission cards per audience (super-admin, tenant, agency, asker) with toggles constrained by granular access rules and an enforce-mode footer switch. Client-side gating maps Keycloak roles to PermissionAction/Resource pairs via userRolesToPermissions and the useUserPermission hook, which also decides which settings tabs and nav entries are visible.

concepts.name: Authentication, Password Reset and 2FA
concepts.summary: Keycloak-backed login with token/session helpers under src/api/auth and route protection via ProtectedRoute. A self-service password-reset flow (request + confirm pages) and per-user two-factor setup (authenticator app or email OTP) are first-class: TwoFactorSetup components serve both the profile page and the onboarding wizard, with a deferral hook for postponable setup.

flows.name: Login → Manage Platform Entities
flows.summary: Admin signs in (Login page, Keycloak-backed; 2FA where enabled) → ProtectedRoute admits the role → a lazy-loaded management page renders → data loads through TanStack Query hooks over the src/api clients → edits are written back to the owning backend service (UserService, TenantService, AgencyService, ConsultingTypeService).

flows.name: Invite Email → Tenant-Admin Onboarding
flows.summary: Admin composes an account invite (Links page) → UserService emails a link containing a raw token → invitee opens /admin/tenant-onboarding/{token} → creates the account → accepts the organisation DPA → completes (or defers) 2FA setup → lands in the admin panel; until the DPA is signed the DpaBlockerGate keeps the rest of the UI locked.

flows.name: Legal Text Edit → Publish
flows.summary: Editor opens a legal document (imprint/privacy/DPA) for a tenant, department or agency → the TipTap editor pins the legal source language → on publish, a warning fires if only translations changed while the source language stayed untouched, and translate-on-publish can regenerate translations → published text is served to the app layer and gates registration/consent there.

flows.name: Statistics Dashboard Load
flows.summary: Statistic page mounts → useStatisticDashboardData queries the UserService useradmin statistics/dashboard endpoint (tutorial stats separately) → responses map into card view-models → StatisticCard animates values, or renders the muted empty-state hint when a metric is not collected yet → card layout preferences persist per user.
